name: Jump

header.Components: V, S, M (a grasshopper’s hind leg)

source.attribution: System Reference Document 5.2.1, Wizards of the Coast LLC; CC BY 4.0.

authored_intent: Bonus Action touch willing creature; once each turn spend 10 feet movement to jump up to 30 feet; higher slots add recipients; not a speed multiplier or free teleport.

rules.text: Once on each of its turns until the spell ends, that creature can jump up to 30 feet by spending 10 feet of movement.
You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.

runtime_draft.coverage: Unverified. Neither a full definition nor a fragment certifies all source rules or controls. Required extensions are not silently waived.

required_extensions.requirement: Execute the declared jump/move with its movement payment, per-turn limit, route and OA rules; do not substitute teleport or unbounded Speed.
